summary: No new evidence or change this cycle, so the draft bytes stand as previously accepted rather than a duplicate revision. The run's record is complete and self-consistent: one asserted defect with an independent witness (shouldSnapshot's unsigned delta underflow makes a store-emptied node report it should snapshot and re-create a snapshot at the unchanged index, CheckRun 9cba2e79ff6c4019b0f0381690d9aaab) whose reachability was then narrowed by measurement (the user-restore producer refuted, CheckRun b78bcab64b0d41b5adaafa98cc0c7f43); three refuted suspicions with retained operands (non-voter commit eligibility; post-restart vote duplication, which also confirmed the durable last vote; the AddVoter configuration lag as a bounded replication transient); and durable Behaviors/Facts for leader append-time configuration and commitment updates, follower latest-configuration-at-store-time, voter-only commit eligibility, durable last-vote reads, and the snapshot-trigger arithmetic. The single unfinished item remains the snapshot-install producer on a follower, which still requires its own fixed experiment.
